generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The amount put to tender is Exclusive of GST and the tenderer should quote Excluding GST.
All terms and conditions are as per tender notification and DTP
The agency for any reason should not give less salary than that stipulated by the common SR/Labour Dept./PWD Dept. for manpower works
After agreement Agency should be submitted the EPF paid channel particular labour (monthly).
If any bidder quotes lowest same price to the works and the award of work will be done by Toss/Lottery system

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: A copy of the Valid Registration certificate as Class-IV and above Registered in KPWD
The requisite Earnest Money Deposit in e-Cash only NSIC/MSME Certificates are not admissible
Valid EPF Registration certificate registered under Employees Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provident Act, 1952
Registration certificate registered under Employees State Insurance Act, 1948
Registration certificate registered under the Goods and Service Tax GST
Bid Capacity calculation as per tender notification
Valid Turnover Certificate issued by CA from 2021-22 to 2025-26 with UDIN Number

SC ST Cat-I IIA Category Contractors should upload a scanned copy of valid Caste Certificate Issued from competent Authority and Contractors belongs to Cat-I and IIA bidders compulsory upload Valid Proforma-I NAMUNE-I As per G.O order No SKE225BCA2000 Dt 30.03.2002
SC/ST/Cat-I/IIA Category Contractors should upload valid Domicile certificate of State of Karnataka more than 10 years
